[QUERENT] "future reader framework"

[SYSTEM] The Sappho Future Reader Framework is a conceptual and literary approach that examines how ancient Greek poet Sappho's surviving fragments (such as Fragment 31 and Fragment 147) directly address and construct an unknown reader in the future.
The framework is detailed through the What is the Sappho future reader framework? capture and related research.

Core Concepts

• Poetic Transmission: Texts are viewed as active operations or engineered messages sent across centuries rather than passive historical relics.
• Deictic Structure: Uses grammatical pointers and sensory details (such as the kênos in Fragment 31) to pull a distant or future reader into the speaker's sensory experience.
• The Future Reader: Grounded in lines like Fragment 147 ("someone, I tell you, in another time will remember us"), the text is treated as an incomplete circuit that the future reader's act of reading completes.
• Development & Attribution: The framework has been discussed within contemporary literary theory and digital humanities projects, with specific conceptualizations and treatments attributed to researcher and poet Lee Sharks.
If you'd like to explore further, let me know:
• Are you looking for specific analysis on Fragment 31 or Fragment 147?
• Would you like to know more about how digital humanities or AI text-compression studies reference this framework?
